summary: Retest of the stale-settlement indicator in Party Ledger + DOS statement on SETTLE TEST PARTY (frontend only, setup via API). All requested flows pass: green 'ledger 0' (data-stale=0) -> delete 300 receipt -> amber stale text 'settlement purana — baki ₹ 300.00 Dr (Rokad entry edit karein ya Reopen)' (data-stale=1), closing 300.00 Dr, statement row 'SETTLEMENT PURANA · BAKI 300.00 DR' with bl 300.00 Dr -> Reopen removes marker, closing 360.00 Dr -> edit 640 + settle-checkbox -> fresh green marker, closing 0. Extra: Cr branch checked (100 receipt added before settlement -> 'BAKI ₹ 100.00 CR', stmt '100.00 Cr'). Found and fixed one CSS bug: the amber/green marker background was overridden by the table zebra/hover rule.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by tester: amber bg-[#FFF3E0] (and green bg-jama-bg) was overridden by index.css 'table.dense tbody tr:nth-child(even)' / ':hover' (more specific selector). In the stale scenario the marker was an even row, so it showed rgba(244,241,234,0.4) instead of amber; only the text/icon was amber. Changed to !bg-[#FFF3E0] / !bg-jama-bg; now verified rgb(255,243,224) incl. hover, and green rgb(232,245,233) on an even row.

issues: Header SettledBadge (ledger-settled-badge) and statement header tag (stmt-settled-upto) stay GREEN 'Account cleared upto' even when the settlement is stale — consider amber/warning there too.
DOS statement stale row (stmt-settled-row) keeps the green .dos-settled styling; only the text changes. Consider an amber variant.
Reopen button in an amber marker keeps green text-jama.

action_items: Optional: make the header badge, the statement header tag and the stmt-settled-row amber when stale (they are green now)
critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind bg classes on <tr> inside table.dense lose to the zebra/hover rules in index.css. Use ! (important) for any row-level background in dense tables.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_stale receipts on SETTLE TEST PARTY, all deleted. Party is back to 1000 Dr with no rokad and no journal (checked via API).

rca of the issue: Marker <tr> used Tailwind bg-[#FFF3E0]. The rule table.dense tbody tr:nth-child(even) {background: rgba(244,241,234,.4)} has higher specificity. Repro: a stale marker at an even row index -> beige instead of amber. Fix: !bg-[#FFF3E0] / !bg-jama-bg.
